# Dreamward

> A private, self-hosted life-design system: a book of your life across 12 categories (vision, purpose, strategy, identity), a current Life Chapter with focus areas, a 1–10 life wheel, IKIGAI, goals and actions, a journal, and Clarity — an AI companion that runs on the user's own AI provider. Every user's data lives in its own database. AI agents connect over MCP, the CLI or a REST API with personal API keys, and every write is audited.

Key facts for agents:
- Start from `get_overview` (MCP) or `GET /api/v1/overview`. It returns the whole book as compact markdown.
- Read keys can only read. Write keys can change data, and every write is audited, so confirm with the user before destructive changes.
- Ratings are append-only. IKIGAI and chapters are versioned: start a draft or a new chapter, don't overwrite history.
- Content is bilingual (English/Hebrew). Answer in the user's language.

## Docs

- [Agent access](docs/agent-access.md): API keys, MCP tools/resources/prompts, `dreamward setup <agent>`, OpenAPI, n8n

- [User guide](docs/user-guide.md): the method and every screen
- [AI providers](docs/ai-providers.md): bring your own AI (API keys, local models, subscriptions via your agent)
- [Self-hosting](docs/self-hosting.md): install, upgrade, backups
- [Backup & restore](docs/backup-restore.md): snapshots, export/import

## API

- OpenAPI 3.1: `/api/v1/openapi.json` on any instance (browsable at `/api/v1/docs`)
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer lbk_…`
